meta.source: The Agency Build Plan v1 (21 Sep 2026); palette revised to maroon + warm greige, 23 Sep 2026

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and window background behind cards and panes. A warm greige, never pure white or pure black.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the list pane, the detail pane, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus and sheets that float above surface.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Hover rows, segmented-control track, skeleton blocks, and (at 60%) the soft page band.

tokens.name: fill-strong
tokens.usage: Selected list row, pressed state, progress-ring track.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Translucent sidebar with backdrop blur. Falls back to bg where blur is unsupported.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Translucent iPhone tab bar and top toolbar, with backdrop blur.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and panes. Decorative only, never the only border of a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and secondary buttons (3:1 on surface in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, fill and sidebar. A near-black with a trace of wine in it.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, meta lines, placeholders, on bg, surface and fill (5.9:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Icons, disabled glyphs and chevrons only. Never body text (3:1 only).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The brand hue, a deep maroon. Primary buttons, active nav, links, progress rings. White text sits on it in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Active sidebar item, selected chip, maroon pill ground, and (at 70%) the lead band of a page.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-soft, and accent-coloured text on dark surfaces.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent fills. White in both themes, because the maroon stays dark in both.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 3px keyboard focus ring on every control (3:1 or better on every surface it lands on).

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Decorative only: the logo's inner stroke, dividers on the landing page, hairline ornament. Never body text, never a control.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: On track, done, accepted. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: green-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for green pills.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: At risk, pending, expiring. Burnt orange, kept clear of the maroon.

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for amber pills and the viewer banner.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Blocked, flags, destructive actions, errors. Brighter and more orange than the maroon so the two never read as one.

tokens.name: red-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for red pills and error messages.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: In review, informational notes. Used sparingly.

tokens.name: blue-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for blue pills.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dim layer behind sheets and modals.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", Inter, sans-serif

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: iPhone large titles and the Today greeting.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Pane titles on desktop, sheet titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Invite teammates by link or email.
styles.usage: Default reading text. Unitless line height so text reflows when a person enlarges it.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: List row titles, buttons, sidebar items.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Row meta lines, field help text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels in the sidebar and forms.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, pill padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside rows and between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, input padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, iPhone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Pane padding, gaps between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page margins on desktop, space above large titles.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Company logo tiles, small chips, keyboard hints.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, list-row highlight.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, grouped lists.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets, modals and the desktop window.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, role badges, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, the company switcher, the command palette.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets and modals.

layout.note: Fixed sizes of the app shell.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar.

tokens.name: list-width
tokens.usage: Desktop middle list pane.

tokens.name: toolbar-height
tokens.usage: Top bar of each desktop pane.

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: iPhone tab bar including the home-indicator area.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum tap area on mobile (Apple HIG).

duration.note: Ease-out for interface motion. Under prefers-reduced-motion, fade only.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, toggles.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Popovers, row selection, route and company switches.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Sheets sliding in, pane changes.

tokens.name: duration-skeleton
tokens.usage: Skeleton shimmer loop.

tokens.name: duration-brand
tokens.usage: The logo sequence on the landing page. Never inside the app.
